mechanism_narrative: When monthly consumer demand proxy GDPC1 exceeds 13,500 billion chained 2017 dollars, S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days are positive due to anticipated corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: In 5-day windows where GDPC1 crosses above 13,500 but S&P 500 5-day returns are non-positive, or during recessions when demand is high yet returns are negative.

mechanism_narrative: Rising monthly employment (PAYEMS) above 132,000 suggests labor market strength that supports corporate optimism and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns negative when PAYEMS rises but macroeconomic news is negative (e.g., inflation data contradicting).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in FEDFUNDS above 0.10% triggers a short-term risk-off reaction, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate rate hikes.
regime_hint: early stage of rate hike cycle
failure_condition: 60-day returns positive when FEDFUNDS spikes but no subsequent rate hike is announced.

mechanism_narrative: When monthly industrial production (INDPRO) exceeds 95.0, indicating supply-side expansion, S&P 500 forward returns over 5 days are positive, reflecting optimism about production capacity.
failure_condition: 5-day returns negative despite INDPRO > 95 when broader macro context is negative (e.g., high inflation).

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive months of rising retail sales (not directly observable here; use proxy RSAFS > 400,000M) suggest sustained demand, producing positive 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day returns flat or negative when RSAFS rises but S&P underperforms due to geopolitical shock.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in unemployment (UNRATE below 5%) combined with rising labor activity (PAYEMS) creates a labor market surprise that drives positive 5-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 5-day returns not positive when UNRATE falls but labor data is missing or contradictory.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary easing phase (FEDFUNDS < 0.02%), a decline in the 12-month inflation proxy CPIAUCSL below 2.0 triggers a positive 60-day S&P 500 forward return as expectations for future rate stability improve.
failure_condition: 60-day returns flat when inflation falls but no change in rate expectations.

mechanism_narrative: When the composite macro momentum (GDPC1 > 13,400 AND HOUST > 620 AND UNRATE < 9) aligns in a bullish cross, S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days are positive, capturing a multi-indicator bullish consensus.
failure_condition: 20-day returns negative despite all trigger conditions met in a non-crisis macro environment.
